source.data:
Earnings Announcement Drift in the 2020s
Jane Doe, Richard Roe
Posted: 3 Mar 2025
Abstract
We revisit post-earnings announcement drift using 2000-2024 data. A long-short portfolio formed on standardized unexpected earnings earns 0.5% per month after transaction costs, concentrated in small and illiquid stocks.
Keywords: PEAD, earnings surprises, market efficiency
